target.exact_signature:
theorem actual_mixture_densities {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) :
    let μ := orthogonalHaar n
    let νpos := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = 1}
    let νneg := (2 : ℝ≥0∞) • μ.restrict
      {O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ | (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det = -1}
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
        Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
          (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let qpos : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂νpos
    let qneg : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => ∫ O, p O x ∂νneg
    (∀ x, 0 ≤ qpos x ∧ 0 ≤ qneg x) ∧
    Measurable qpos ∧ Measurable qneg ∧
    Integrable qpos volume ∧ Integrable qneg volume ∧
    (∫ x, qpos x) = 1 ∧ (∫ x, qneg x) = 1 ∧
    νpos.bind γ = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (qpos x)) ∧
    νneg.bind γ = volume.withDensity (fun x => ENNReal.ofReal (qneg x))

definition_audit.name: singleBlockPrecision
definition_audit.meaning: Reuse literal Eq4 producer; no new matrix definition. Its inverse is covariance of actual Mathlib multivariateGaussian.

definition_audit.name: orthogonalHaar
definition_audit.meaning: Same audited canonical full O(n) Haar constructor/specification, both determinant signs.

definition_audit.name: νpos,νneg
definition_audit.meaning: Exactly twice canonical full Haar restricted to detO=±1. Probability and half mass come from canonical component producers, internally.

definition_audit.name: γ
definition_audit.meaning: Actual standard Mathlib multivariateGaussian(0, A_O inverse), not a parameterized placeholder law. SPD/covariance facts internally produced.

definition_audit.name: p
definition_audit.meaning: The full standard real Gaussian precision-density formula on every x. Existing gaussian_law_eq_density supplies its actual law correspondence; real n/2, Euclidean dot product/norm and Lebesgue base are fixed.

definition_audit.name: qpos,qneg
definition_audit.meaning: Literal real Bochner average of p_O under each actual conditioned prior gives the chosen pointwise representative of the source density p_b. Source density is only determined Lebesgue-a.e.; withDensity equalities certify this representative, so all source density/affinity integrals are unaffected by a.e. representative choice. No claim is made that the paper fixes a different arbitrary density representative pointwise. Pointwise inner absolute integrability will be proved internally, so totalized integral zero on nonintegrable functions is not used as a fallback.

definition_audit.name: withDensity
definition_audit.meaning: Actual volume.withDensity(ofReal(q)) measure. Pointwise nonnegativity, measurability, genuine L1 and real mass1 are conclusions, not assumptions.
